description: This file defines the WorkshopSponsor class, a model representing workshop sponsors within the Goteo application. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and validating sponsor data, and manages associated images.

classes.name: WorkshopSponsor
classes.description: Model class representing a workshop sponsor, with properties for sponsor attributes and methods for data retrieval, saving, image handling, and validation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a workshop sponsor by ID from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current workshop sponsor instance to the database after validation.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the associated Image object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the sponsor data, primarily checking that the name is not empty.
